headline: Restrictive and leaning tighter: the October minutes showed almost all officials expect further hikes, Waller floated 50 bp, and futures price ~97% odds of at least +25 bp on Dec 9, pushing the dollar to a 19-month high near 103.9. Haven demand pulled the 10-year to 5.07% and oil slid to $83 WTI on a crude build, but HY spreads widened to ~343 bp as the tech sell-off weighs on risk appetite. Underwrite floating-rate debt 25–50 bp higher after December, keep the 10-year above 5% in hurdle rates, and lock fixed-rate financing on dips while credit windows stay open.
